title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. translated_title: SAUL：锐度感知的增广拉格朗日机器遗忘方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16249v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）中的机器遗忘面临着一个关键权衡：在擦除目标知识与保持通用实用性之间如何平衡。我们提出了SAUL（锐度感知的增广拉格朗日机器遗忘方法），该方法将遗忘问题形式化为一个遵循“忘记足够多，但不过度”原则的约束最小化问题。SAUL的核心在于，将遗忘表述为一个带有预设满足标准的显式约束，而先前的遗忘方法通常通过优化目标隐式地指定所需的遗忘程度。一个增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反情况自适应地调整遗忘侧的压力，并能在预设标准持续满足时最终停用遗忘侧的更新。对保留和遗忘目标进行的锐度感知更新，结合一种维持角色分离状态的双优化器设计，进一步增强了稳定性。
tldr: 本文提出了SAUL，一种通过显式约束和增广拉格朗日控制器来自适应控制遗忘程度，并利用锐度感知更新和双优化器设计来平衡机器遗忘中知识擦除与模型实用性保持的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAUL, a method that uses explicit constraints and an augmented Lagrangian controller to adaptively control forgetting intensity, combined with sharpness-aware updates and a dual-optimizer design to balance knowledge erasure and utility preservation in machine unlearning.
